title: Google Play App Details Scraper
description: Get Google Play app details with developer, rating, review totals, downloads, category, permissions, and media links. Batch package names by country.

schema.description: Google Play product id. For apps this is the package name.
Public source page URL used to retrieve this record.
Country code for the storefront (2 letters, e.g. us, de).
Google Play store vertical: apps, movies, tv, books, or audiobooks. Accepted values: apps, movies, tv, books, audiobooks.
TV season id for Google Play TV products.
Request Google Play review-expanded product pages when available.
Review platform filter, such as phone, tablet, tv, chromebook, watch, or car. Accepted values: phone, tablet, tv, chromebook, watch, car.
Review rating filter from 1 to 5. Accepted values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
Review sort mode, such as 1, 2, 3, most_relevant, newest, or rating. Accepted values: 1, 2, 3, most_relevant, newest, rating.
Requested review result count for clients that need SerpApi-compatible parameters.
Review pagination token for clients that need SerpApi-compatible parameters.

storeCopy.seoTitle: Google Play App Details | Ratings & Downloads
storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Google Play app details by package name. Export developer, rating, review count, downloads, categories, permissions, and media links by country.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve public Google Play app listings with developer information, ratings, review totals, downloads, categories, permissions, and media links. Look up several package names in one run.
useCases: App teams can compare listing details and public ratings across competitors.
Mobile analysts can monitor download bands, categories, and update information.
Product researchers can collect app metadata for a storefront catalog.
howToUse: Add one app package name to each entry in `apps`.
Choose the Google Play country and language for the storefront response.
Review the product details, ratings, and permission summary in the dataset.

faqs.question: Where do I find an app package name?
faqs.answer: Copy the value after `id=` in the Google Play listing URL, such as `com.spotify.music`.
